raw_text: This is a demo MVP; prefer simple, readable, composable code. Backend: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs/EF Core (`src/BudgetTracker.Api/`), feature folders `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`; frontend: React 18/TypeScript/Vite/Tailwind (`src/BudgetTracker.Web/`), Router v7, Axios, strict mode. Use clear names; no code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead. Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest); tests snake_case; Testcontainers; NSubstitute. Features: dual auth, anti-forgery, tenant isolation, CSV import, Azure OpenAI, pgvector, background recommendations, NLP query assistance. `dotnet watch run`; `dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"`; `dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName`; `dotnet ef database update`; `npm run dev`; `npm run build`; `npm run lint`; `docker compose up -d`; `docker compose down`. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
